languages: can also understand Auran but can't speak it

spellcasting.name: Spellcasting

spells.name: Light
spells.components: V, M (a firefly or phosphorescent moss)

spells.name: Sanctuary

traits.name: Glide
traits.descriptionHtml: When falling at least 10 feet, Ardwyn can spend a reaction to fly up to her speed in one direction as she descends. She lands in an unoccupied space at the end of her movement, and takes no falling damage. She cannot glide while carrying heavy objects, heavy weapons, or shields (though she can drop any held items as part of her reaction).
